annotations.title: Leave a message for a business

description: Drop the user's feedback (a suggestion, a problem or a compliment) into a business's private suggestion box on SuggestionBox.tips. Private between the user and the business. Confirm the wording with the user before sending. Give the website when you know it; otherwise the business name and its city.

business.description: The business website (best) or its name.

city.description: City, needed when there is no website.

email.description: Optional. The user's email, only if they want to hear back.

ref.description: Optional order or booking number the message is about.

text.description: The message, in the user's words.

name: leave_message
title: Leave a message for a business
